description: This PHP source file defines the CustomLoader class within the Api\Core\Loader namespace. It provides static methods for managing custom file paths, merging arrays, including custom configuration files, and loading custom routes, primarily used for extending or customizing SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM functionality.

classes.name: CustomLoader
classes.description: A class providing static methods for loading custom configuration and route files, merging arrays, and managing error states within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM extension.

methods.name: setCustomPath
methods.description: Sets the directory path for custom files.

methods.name: getCustomPath
methods.description: Retrieves the current custom file path.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error code and resets it to no error.

methods.name: mergeCustomArray
methods.description: Includes a custom PHP file that returns an array and merges it with an existing array.

methods.name: loadCustomRoutes
methods.description: Includes a custom routes PHP file into the application.
